from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
{'pillow':Image.__version__ if hasattr(Image,'__version__') else 'available','package':driver.current_package}

import time, io, math
video = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ANDROID_UIAUTOMATOR, 'new UiSelector().descriptionContains("Video: ZwUN_moment_70_")')
t0=time.monotonic(); video.click()
WebDriverWait(driver,6).until(lambda d: d.current_activity != '.gui.MainActivity')
frames=[]; times=[]
for i in range(38):
    target=t0+0.35+i*0.65
    delay=target-time.monotonic()
    if delay>0: time.sleep(delay)
    frames.append(driver.get_screenshot_as_png())
    times.append(time.monotonic()-t0)
# contact sheets, preserving full frame
sheets=[]
for start in range(0,len(frames),10):
    chunk=frames[start:start+10]
    thumbs=[]
    for j,b in enumerate(chunk):
        im=Image.open(io.BytesIO(b)).convert('RGB')
        im.thumbnail((480,240))
        canvas=Image.new('RGB',(500,280),'white')
        canvas.paste(im,((500-im.width)//2,30+(240-im.height)//2))
        ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((8,7),f'{start+j}: {times[start+j]:.2f}s',fill='black')
        thumbs.append(canvas)
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1000,math.ceil(len(thumbs)/2)*280),'#888888')
    for k,th in enumerate(thumbs): sheet.paste(th,((k%2)*500,(k//2)*280))
    out=io.BytesIO(); sheet.save(out,format='PNG'); sheets.append(out.getvalue())
for s in sheets: display(s,mime_type='image/png')
{'activity':driver.current_activity,'frameCount':len(frames),'times':[round(x,2) for x in times]}
